annotations.title: Save a stills layout as a template

description: Save the layout of a stills post as a template of this workspace: where the photo slots are, their layers, the frame, the number of slides and (for a grid span) the rows. Photos, words and stickers are not kept. Call it after the layout looks right (stills_preview). Pass post_id (from stills_create), name, optionally use_for, and base_rev (the rev from stills_get) so a layout changed since you looked is refused with INVALID_STATE: read it again with stills_get, check it, and call again. It returns the template (id starting ws-): pass that id as template in stills_create with other media_ids, or in a template.apply operation of stills_change, to make the same layout from different photos. The template appears in stills_templates_list. Only this workspace can see or use it.

base_rev.description: The rev you last read (stills_get). A layout changed since is refused, so the template is the layout you saw

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

use_for.description: When to use it, in a short sentence

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_template_save
